fields.label: Currency Note
fields.options: All amounts are in pounds sterling (GBP, £). No ERPNext data is read or written.

fields.description: Choose how orders are fulfilled. This controls which fulfilment cost field is used below.
fields.label: Fulfilment

fields.description: FBA uses Amazon's fulfilment fee. Merchant uses your own shipping cost.
fields.label: Fulfilment method

fields.description: What you pay for one unit, before shipping and prep.
fields.label: Buy price (£)

fields.description: Inbound freight, prep and handling to get one unit to Amazon. Set to 0 for Merchant fulfilment if you do not ship to Amazon.
fields.label: Shipping to Amazon (£)

fields.description: Labels, polybags, inspection, duty or any other per-unit cost.
fields.label: Other costs (£)

fields.description: The per-unit price the customer pays on Amazon.
fields.label: Sale price (£)

fields.description: Amazon referral fee as a percentage of the sale price. 15% applies to most categories.
fields.label: Referral fee (%)

fields.description: Amazon's FBA fulfilment fee for the product's size and weight tier. Used when Fulfilment method is FBA.
fields.label: FBA fulfilment fee (£)

fields.description: What it costs you to ship one unit to the customer. Used when Fulfilment method is Merchant.
fields.label: Shipping Cost (£)

fields.description: Sale price minus the referral fee, selected fulfilment cost, buy price, shipping and other costs.
fields.label: Profit per unit (£)

fields.description: Profit divided by the sale price.
fields.label: Margin (%)

fields.description: Sale price multiplied by the referral fee percentage.
fields.label: Referral fee (£)

fields.description: Profit divided by the buy price, shipping and other costs.
fields.label: ROI (%)

fields.description: Referral fee plus the selected fulfilment cost, buy price, shipping and other costs.
fields.label: Total costs (£)

fields.description: The sale price at which profit is £0.
fields.label: Breakeven sale price (£)

fields.description: Work backwards from the margin you want. The buy price, fulfilment cost, shipping and other costs above are kept exactly as entered.
fields.label: Target margin

fields.description: The margin you want to achieve. Enter 30 for 30%.
fields.label: Target margin (%)

fields.description: Sale price needed to achieve the target margin, using the buy price, fulfilment cost, shipping and other costs above.
fields.label: Sale price if Margin 30% (£)
Formula Reference
fields.options:
Profit per unit = sale price − referral fee − fulfilment cost − buy price − shipping to Amazon − other costs

Fulfilment cost = FBA fulfilment fee when Fulfilment method is FBA, or Shipping Cost when it is Merchant

Referral fee = sale price × referral fee %

ROI = profit ÷ (buy price + shipping to Amazon + other costs)

Margin = profit ÷ sale price

Breakeven sale price = (buy price + fulfilment cost + shipping to Amazon + other costs) ÷ (1 − referral fee %)

Sale price if Margin M% = (buy price + fulfilment cost + shipping to Amazon + other costs) ÷ (1 − referral fee % − M%)

A 15% referral fee is entered as 15, not 0.15. Percentages are calculated on the unrounded inputs, and money is displayed to two decimal places.
